activities.title: Wake + Hydration
activities.instructions: Wake up and drink 1-2 glasses of water

activities.title: Warm-up
activities.instructions: Neck rolls, shoulder rotations, light mobility exercises

activities.title: Cool Down + Stretch
activities.instructions: Stretch neck, shoulders, and upper back. Slow breathing

activities.title: Meditation
activities.instructions: Breathing meditation using guided audio

activities.title: Sunlight Exposure
activities.instructions: Get 10-15 minutes of sunlight exposure

activities.title: Study Session (Deep Work)
activities.instructions: 2 × 30 min focus blocks with 5 min break. No phone, no distractions

activities.title: Breakfast + Coffee + Get Ready
activities.instructions: Eat breakfast, have coffee, and get ready calmly without rushing

activities.title: Commute to Office
activities.instructions: Listen to educational audio or podcasts, or relax mind. Avoid random scrolling and stress thinking

activities.title: Work Block 1
activities.instructions: Focus on high-priority tasks

activities.title: Office Work (Focused Work)
activities.instructions: Work in 45–60 min blocks with 3–5 min breaks. Follow 20-20-20 rule and stretch neck every 1–2 hours

activities.title: Green Tea Break
activities.instructions: Drink green tea and take a short refresh break

activities.title: Lunch & Recovery
activities.instructions: Eat mindfully, short walk

activities.title: Work Block 2
activities.instructions: Meetings and collaborative work

activities.title: Afternoon Reset Break
activities.instructions: 2 min deep breathing and short walk if possible

activities.title: Commute Back Home
activities.instructions: Listen to calm music, light podcast, or stay silent. Avoid work thinking

activities.title: Evening Recovery
activities.instructions: 15–20 min walk, light stretching, optional shower

activities.title: Optional Study (Light)
activities.instructions: Light revision or practice. Skip if mentally tired

activities.title: Dinner
activities.instructions: Eat a light and balanced dinner

activities.title: Turmeric Latte
activities.instructions: Drink turmeric latte for recovery and relaxation

activities.title: No Screens + Wind Down
activities.instructions: Avoid screens and start winding down

activities.title: Chamomile Tea
activities.instructions: Drink chamomile tea for relaxation

activities.title: Body Scan Meditation
activities.instructions: Guided body scan meditation for deep relaxation

activities.title: Sleep
activities.instructions: 7–8 hours of quality sleep
